items.claim: Elise Reed's ground game is decent, but she does not present much danger on the feet.
items.quote: I think her ground game is decent on the feet, not a ton of danger, but does have solid technique.

items.claim: Elise Reed has a history of being finished by strikes and submissions when losing in the UFC.
items.quote: Elise Reed, when she's been losing in the UFC, it's normally her getting finished.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer utilizes a reach advantage effectively with nasty striking, excellent kicks, and heavy body attacks.
items.quote: Chanel Dyer is going to use that to her advantage. She's got nasty striking, excellent kicks, will attack the lead leg, take away your base, rip to the body very well

items.claim: Wes Schultz is the better overall grappler in this matchup compared to Jackson McVey.
items.quote: Wes Schultz is the better overall grappler here.

items.claim: Jackson McVey is quite a bit better than Wes Schultz on the feet with rangy tools and a strong clinch game.
items.quote: on the feet, I think Jackson McVey is quite a bit better, right? Jackson McVeyy's got some good rangy tools... very, very good in the clinch

items.claim: Wes Schultz previously submitted Jackson McVey easily during their amateur days.
items.quote: Wes Schultz was able to submit Jackson McVey pretty easily.

items.claim: Wes Schultz's gas tank can be a little bit suspect at times.
items.quote: Wes Schultz's gas tank can be a little bit suspect.

items.claim: Stan Dorsainville is capable of being pretty decent in the UFC and winning this fight.
items.quote: Stan Dorsainville is a guy that could potentially be pretty decent in the UFC. And I think that he's actually very capable of winning this fight
